name: two-coordinate diagonal-conditioning baseline, all-to-all diagonal layer (axes design)

model.ansatz: iqp_cond.Ansatz.complete(16): 16 one-body Z_i followed by all 120 Z_iZ_j pairs in numpy triu order (136 phases), the generator set of the Curie-Weiss models
model.input_state: fixed |0>^16 for every condition (standard IQP Born machine); AngleEncoder with zero RY angles
model.circuit: q(x|u,v) = |<x| H^16 exp(i sum_g theta_g(u,v) Z_g) H^16 |0>^16|^2
model.diagonal_map: theta(u,v) = w_0 + u w_u + v w_v
model.weights_layout: flattened (3,136) array with rows w_0, w_u, w_v
model.initialization: w_0 = numpy default_rng(seed).normal(0, init_scale, 136) plus local_mean on the 16 one-body entries (the first 40 draws coincide with the lattice stream but are assigned to different generators beyond the one-body block); all other rows zero. init_scale was kept at 0.1 on every entry although there are now 120 pairs rather than 24, and no init_scale candidates were added, so the search size stays matched to the conditional IQP campaign.
model.rationale: Under axis-only training a bilinear u*v term is unidentifiable, so the affine map is the natural diagonal-conditioning counterpart; mixed pairs are additive extrapolation in parameter space. The |+>^16 input is excluded because H D(theta) H |+> is proportional to |+> and gives the uniform law for every theta.
model.connectivity_rationale: Tests whether the gap to conditional IQP is a connectivity effect: the C-IQP encoder imposes the width through J_z^2, which places phases on all 120 qubit pairs, whereas the lattice baseline's diagonal layer has only 24 couplings.

deviations: Candidate local_mean grid is {0, pi/4} instead of the parent {0, pi/3}: for the |0> input a one-body phase of pi/4 on every qubit (all other phases zero) gives the uniform distribution, the target at the origin.
The fixed |0> input does not pin the origin: the model at (0,0) is theta = w_0 and is learned, not architecturally uniform.
selection: mean exact full TVD at development conditions; reporting excluded
stages: screen all 4 candidates (1 seed) -> shortlist 2 by best development score -> confirmation (2 seeds) -> winner by mean confirmation development score -> frozen winner -> final (5 seeds); reporting conditions evaluated only for final fits
limitations: Baseline for the axes design only; no grid or translation fits.
Development selection uses exact target probabilities, as in the parent protocol.
Affine theta map fixed; no search over richer condition maps.
init_scale kept at 0.1 with 120 pair phases; the larger initial pair-phase variance is not re-tuned.

diagonal_parent_protocol.differences: Only the diagonal-layer ansatz differs from this lattice parent (complete one- and two-body layer instead of the open 4x4 lattice); fields changed accordingly: name, ansatz, model.ansatz, model.weights_layout, model.n_parameters, model.initialization, model.connectivity_rationale, limitations. The basis, conditions, candidates, budgets, seeds, rng offsets, selection and stages are unchanged.
